summary: USER QUESTION: why are we using TREE_ATTN (separate Triton kernel, 0.00195 vs FLASH) for decode instead of OUR FA2-fork (native FLASH + additive -inf tree bias, byte-exact floor 14/16 whole-tree 0.0)? The FA2-fork is currently PREFILL-only (FR13_FA2_PREFILL_NATIVE). CPU read-only: root-cause WHY it is prefill-only, whether it can serve DECODE tree-verify + CUDA-graph-capture + B=4, and whether routing decode full-attn through it would CLOSE the 0.00195 deliverable-vs-E5 residual. Reward-hack check (FLASH+tree-mask is the user-sanctioned fallback, NOT a reroute). Adversarial verify.

inv.whyPrefillOnly: PREMISE FALSE: the FA2-fork is NOT prefill-only. The locked build (fr13_launch_locked.sh:24-26) sets FR13_FA2_TREE_BIAS=1, and fr13_patch_fa2_tree_bias.py:569-644 (_patch_tree_attn decode branch) rewrites TreeAttentionImpl's DECODE path to: `if FR13_FA2_TREE_BIAS==1 and use_tree_bias (max_query_len>1): flash_attn_varlen_func(...tree_bias=...) [THE FORK]  else: unified_attention(...qq_bias=...) [TREE_ATTN-Triton fallback]`. cat9 has max_query_len=tree_len=9>1 with a non-empty -inf bias, so the DECODE tree rows go through the fork. The "prefill-only" wording is a NAMING SLIP: FR13_FA2_PREFILL_NATIVE (fr13_patch_fa2_tree_bias.py:471-560) is a SEPARATE prefill-specific flag that routes the PREFILL full-attn through native FLASH (no bias). The recent bind (FR13_TOTAL_DRIFT_REANALYSIS_LEADS_BIND.md:7-9) conflated the backend NAME (TREE_ATTN, true at boot echo) with the decode IMPL (the fork). git fe21cb73 confirms the fork was the ORIGINAL decode design ('route TREE_ATTN decode through forked FA2 with -inf tree_bias'); the 14/16 byte-exact floor was measured on the DECODE strict run fr13_verify_strict_tree_20260607T091935Z.
inv.canServeDecode: YES on all four axes - it already does. (a) tree-depth positions + tree-ancestry additive bias: decode_meta.tree_attn_bias (0 on ancestors, -inf else) threaded as fork tree_bias=, added to acc_s post-QK pre-softmax (apply_tree_bias :26-74; set_params_tree_bias :181-214); verified true -inf (LADDER_LOG:56). (b) paged KV block layout: tree-verify is a VARLEN forward over paged KV - flash_attn_varlen_func passes block_table=decode_meta.block_table + seqused_k directly into the SAME torch.ops._vllm_fa2_C.varlen_fwd op (flash_attn_interface.py:300-311, guard :268), the same op the fork wraps via mha_varlen_fwd_impl (:233-314). There is NO separate decode-paged vs prefill-varlen kernel for this path on GB10 (FA3-paged is gated on device_capability_family(90); GB10=family 120 takes the FA2 varlen_fwd path the fork patches). (c) CUDA-graph capture: CONFIRMED FULL (LADDER_LOG:164-166, 'Profiling CUDA graph memory: PIECEWISE=8 FULL=4', 'Capturing CUDA graphs (decode, FULL)' completed). (d) B=4: CONFIRMED boots/captures/serves (LADDER_LOG:28,162, MAX_NUM_SEQS=4). Nothing is missing - the fork is the deployed decode kernel.
inv.graphCaptureB4: YES. The forked-FA2 TREE_ATTN tree arm FULL-captures and serves at B=4: FR13_LADDER_LOG.md:164-166 logs 'Profiling CUDA graph memory: PIECEWISE=8 (largest=80), FULL=4 (largest=40)' and 'Capturing CUDA graphs (decode, FULL)' completed before startup, with MAX_NUM_SEQS=4 (:28, :162). The static tree_bias buffer is fixed-shape and capture-friendly. So the 'TREE_ATTN was chosen partly for capture' rationale does not distinguish it from the fork - the fork-as-decode-kernel also FULL-captures at B=4. Caveat: the one B=4 e2e that ran with the fork FAILED the deliverable gates, but that run predated FR13_FA2_PREFILL_NATIVE (prefill drift), not a capture/serve failure.
inv.wouldCloseResidual: NO - there is nothing to close. The 0.00195 is the EXP2-Triton TREE_ATTN unified_attention residual (the FALLBACK path, reached only when FR13_FA2_TREE_BIAS=0 or max_query_len==1). The locked build SHADOWS that path off (FR13_FA2_TREE_BIAS=1), so the live full-attn decode kernel is ALREADY the fork. The fork's full-attn decode residual is its OWN floor: 14/16 calls whole-tree byte-exact 0.0, 15/16 spine byte-exact, exactly 2 single-bf16-ULP elements in ~983k (max 0.0039), root-caused to irreducible MMA fp32 fragment-grouping over the scattered no-copy KV (flash_fwd_kernel.h:367 gemm_rs) - ~15x below the E5 ~0.059 floor, i.e. argmax/distributionally lossless on the full-attn layers. The decode tree-verify is a varlen fwd over the SAME paged op the fork wraps, so it does NOT introduce a NEW residual vs prefill. The actual e2e deliverable MISS (bag-TV 0.42-0.50, LADDER_LOG:31,172) is carried UPSTREAM at L0 GDN linear_attention (0.0078, node7 ladder), upstream of the first full-attn layer L3 (0.00409) - a full-attn kernel swap is structurally incapable of removing an L0-GDN-born divergence.
inv.treeAttnAliveAtB4: The deployed decode kernel (the FA2-fork, dispatched under the TREE_ATTN backend name) IS confirmed CUDA-graph FULL-capturing and serving at B=4 (LADDER_LOG:164-166, 28). What has NOT been achieved is a CLEAN B=4 deliverable PASS - the one B=4 e2e (LADDER_LOG:162) failed (accept/event 1.1134 vs E5 3.076, bag-TV 0.50 vs 0.059) but predates FR13_FA2_PREFILL_NATIVE (=prefill drift, a structural break, not the fork decode call). On the 0.00195 question: that number (the EXP2-Triton fallback residual) is WITHIN the ~0.059 E5 floor numerically, but it is MOOT for the locked config because the fork (floor 0.0039, also within) is what runs. The real e2e deliverable miss (bag-TV 0.42-0.50) is BEYOND the floor and is carried by L0 GDN, NOT the full-attn kernel. So 'within E5 floor -> TREE_ATTN deploy wins' is already satisfied for the full-attn sub-question; the deliverable is gated upstream.

TREE_ATTN(=the fork-decode kernel) IS confirmed capturing+serving at B=4; 0.00195 is within the floor (but moot).
inv.rewardHackCheck: LEGITIMATE deliverable, NOT a reroute/splice. The FA2-fork is FLASH + an additive -inf tree-mask bias computed IN the real serving path; byte-exactness is verified against the native-FA2-on-path oracle with the SPLICE OFF (the fork genuinely computes the tree attention - FR13_FA2_TREE_BIAS_FORK.md:35, project_fr13_fa2_fork_nocopy_floor). The reroute ban (feedback_no_reroute_reward_hacking) targets routing OUR computation THROUGH native to pass a metric while our kernel stays unused; this is the opposite - the fork IS the deployed verifier kernel, nothing is copied or re-streamed from a native call. CONFIRMED legitimate (FLASH+tree-mask = the user-sanctioned fallback). The only flag is that the QUESTION's framing (swap decode to the fork) is MOOT not reward-hacking: the fork is already the decode kernel, so 'swapping' ships no new deliverable.
inv.gpuTestPlan: The swap is a no-op on the locked config (the fork is already the decode kernel), so a 'route decode through the fork' test re-measures what is deployed. Two tests are worth GPU IF the full-attn sub-question is wanted independently of the L0-GDN carrier. Test A (cheap, confirmatory): boot fr13_launch_locked.sh (fork decode + FR13_FA2_PREFILL_NATIVE=1, B=1 eager, hooks ON); capture each full-attn layer attn_out for the cat9 tree decode vs native-FLASH-on-path oracle (spine vs native chain; each branch vs its native-on-path oracle per reference_gdn_tree_branch_oracle_losslessness). EXPECT 14/16 whole-tree 0.0, <=2 single-ULP, all within ~0.059 - confirms the live full-attn decode residual is the fork floor (0.0039), NOT 0.00195. Test B (the actual open gate, never passed cleanly post-prefill-native): clean B=4 CUDA-graph e2e, TREE_ATTN + FR13_FA2_TREE_BIAS=1 + FR13_FA2_PREFILL_NATIVE=1, MAX_NUM_SEQS=4, enforce_eager=False, hooks/metrics OFF; gates bag-TV vs E5 (output/fr10_native_mtp5_same8_20260604T210257Z, accept/event 3.076) <=0.0593 AND accept/event>=3.076. PREDICTION: still FAILS bag-TV, carried by L0-GDN co-residency - so Test B is a GDN-front test, not a full-attn-kernel test. Do NOT self-declare pass; bring the E5-vs-fork table to the user. Do NOT patch native FLASH for decode or build a new full-attn kernel (the residual is already at the fork floor / within E5 floor; the miss is upstream).
